insights.statement: Mix explains 1.4 pp of the 1.9 pp gross-margin decline: electronics rose from 13.2% to 19.9% of sales at an 11.5% margin
insights.decision_relevance: The recovery plan must target electronics mix and margin, not volume

insights.statement: Revenue grew 7.4% to €1,460M, so the volume explanation does not hold
Within categories margins slipped only 0.45 pp, led by apparel (−1 pp) and grocery and electronics (−0.5 pp each)
Freight cost rose €9M (+23.7%) after the new carrier contract, a profit gap outside gross margin
insights.decision_relevance: Needs a separate procurement action; it does not count toward the margin target

insights.statement: Electronics sells 6% below the main competitor; 3 pp more electronics margin would add about 0.6 pp to group margin
insights.decision_relevance: Fastest lever toward the 1.5 pp target
insights.caveat: 0.6 pp assumes half of the price gap converts into margin

insights.statement: Repricing electronics (0.6 pp) and steering it back to 17% of sales (0.5 pp) recover about 1.1 pp; the remaining 0.4 pp of the 1.5 pp target must come from regaining within-category margins (0.45 pp lost in FY2025)
insights.decision_relevance: Defines the plan the board is asked to approve
insights.caveat: 0.6 pp and 0.5 pp rest on assumptions A001 and A002
